text: The two legacy criteria of RWB-E6-036 are kept word for word and are tested on a synthetic set of this run: case RC-2026-000555 of product group MORTGAGE, held asset AST-2026-000555 with book value 3,200,000.00 THB, business date 2026-12-31 and the provision-input rule rows in force. The detail behind the generic legacy lines is filled from FSD P8 A2.8 and BR-054, the four legacy test case IDs keep their own rows in the Test Cases master, and no contract story of this legacy key owns any of the criteria.
why: The legacy criteria and their four test cases name no case, product group, amount, asset or date, the FSD main success criterion is one line marked Written one epic ahead, and the story cannot be built or tested without a stated data set.
read: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Test cases); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.4.1; Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 BR-054; work package line for RWB-P8-E6036-APP
confirm: P8 business analyst at the E6 test data review
impact: The test data and the traceability rows only; both criteria, their wording and the four test case IDs are unchanged

text: The provision-input build reads its rule rows, its provision step, its thresholds, its re-appraisal interval and the period of the input from rwb-decision at the version in force, and never from a value of the build; the field list of an input row is derived from the legacy Data table, proceeds and BR-054 and stays the answer shape of the step; the build runs once per business date on the completed ACE batch of source ALS, inside the service's ACE-batch-started run family; and the run and activity names carry a placeholder until the Temporal Workflow and Activity Catalog publishes them.
why: No source publishes the provision-input field list, its period or its frequency, the package code and rule IDs of the family, the provision step thresholds or the names of the run and the activity, and the build cannot be evaluated or asserted without a stated reading.
read: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Data, Endpoints); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.1, A2.8.2, A2.8.3.1 and A2.8.4.4; TSD P8 v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T-A.1; Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 ASM-012 and Q-005
confirm: P7 rule owner and the P8 solution architect at the rule package review
impact: The answer shape, the names and the values of the rules only; the criteria, the messages and the 2 s budget are unchanged

text: rwb-payment holds no grant on the recovery.v_ace_* views and no grant on another rwb_* schema, so the receipts and the ACE batch status are read on the rwb-source-data contract, the case position on the rwb-case contract and the held-asset position on the rwb-asset contract, each one hop with a 2 s budget; the legacy v_ace_payment, v_ace_npa_asset and v_ace_batch_status reads are retired, and VR-P8-008-1 with MSG-P1-001 is kept exactly as the FSD states it.
why: The legacy story reads three ACE views in process and the asset facts it needs are owned by rwb-asset in the target, so the story cannot be built against grants it will not have.
read: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Data); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.3.1; context pack P8; Architecture v5 slides 4 and 29; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-05
confirm: P1 source-data owner, S5 asset owner and the P8 solution architect at the contract review
impact: Three read paths and the grants only; the stale-data rule, its message and every criterion are unchanged

text: The built provision-input set is the answer of the build step: no table, no column and no event is created for it, and it is neither staged in rwb_payment nor delivered to Finance by this story; the finance provision feed, its file layout, its interface number, its transport, its retry policy and its acknowledgement stay out of scope until an interface is published, while the month-end close window of R-WO-26 is read as a policy timer of the write-off route and not as a Schedule of this service.
why: No source publishes a provision-input table, an outbound interface for the finance feed, its layout, transport or acknowledgement, and the story cannot persist or deliver what is not published.
read: Legacy RWB-E6-036 (Endpoints); FSD P8 v3 A2.8.2; TSD P8 v2 T3.1 and T5.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-WO-26 and R-WO-27; context pack P8
confirm: P8 solution architect and the finance-feed interface owner at the interface review
impact: The persistence and the delivery of the input set only; the build, its record and its build-once key are unchanged
